strAuthor: phobosgekko; guidance adapted from Gravy/mrkmg's Auto Navigate
strNotes: RCS approach and braking for ordinary saves. Requires BepInEx 5, the accompanying PhobosAutoNav plugin and Phobos Framework 0.6.0+. Available from traders or table assembly, with repair, Restore and mass-balanced dismantling. No Auto Navigate dependency. Does not dock or avoid obstacles. Original Phobos artwork; adaptation provenance in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Economy integration awaits in-game testing.
